answer.rationale: Compliance forbids reverting the security release, so rollback is closed regardless of memory_b1. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) fail fast and would drop peak settlement writes, which violates the no-lost-writes objective. Failover has no regional fault signal and would move in-flight peak writes. The live symptom is write-path p99 at 5x under heavy daily-peak writes; that aligns better with headroom (memory_b3) than with offloading report reads (memory_b5). Intend to add capacity now to protect availability without shedding customer writes. Verifying memory_b3 because it describes provisioning before a peak and may not apply mid-surge; root cause (release regression vs load) remains uncertain.
